experiment: Voice Setup changes P, T and R compared as arms on DAPS script 1 recorded on consumer devices
limitations: Loudspeaker playback of read speech, one script, not a live talker: no raised voice, movement or close-microphone bass, the same delivery in every room, and room tone that includes the loudspeaker's hiss.

The reference is the dry studio take. Device and room are confounded: ipadflat appears only in office1 and confroom1, iphone only in livingroom1 and bedroom1. Speech labels come from the clean take's energy.

Users whose noise had to be spliced from several pauses are flagged and reported apart; users without 2.0 s of pause material, or without an aligned evaluation window, are excluded, counted and listed, never replaced.

170 analysed user-conditions in 17 speaker clusters, so the budgets (9, 18 and 18, fixed whatever the number of exclusions) are not confirmed at 95 %: a pass whose interval reaches past its limit is labelled 'within budget on this cohort, not confirmed at 95 %', and a miss by one is a miss.

The current settings are the factory preset, or the factory preset plus one of three hand-set tone EQ library entries. The evidence for R comes from factory users only: an existing user's saved strength does not change.
The tone clause is nearly blind below 1 kHz, so T's benefit rests on injected errors at 100 and 200 Hz, not on errors the recordings contain.
For a recording refused at capture (A) and for an unclear recording (B1) the judged object is the proposal had the refusal not happened, a counterfactual the product discards.
df.dll is a local build whose SHA-256 differs from release-assets.json; both hashes are recorded.

RNNoise default strength 0.7 and the by-band tonal check were rejected before (evaluation/README.md rows 'Voice Setup verification' and 'Voice Setup verification, tonal check by band'); DAPS is the new evidence.
The refusal study found that the compressor step is the only worse step for most correctly refused setups; that bounds what any change here can show.

labels.not_confirmed: within budget on this cohort, not confirmed at 95 %

metrics.reading: false refusal and false accept counts are the headline readings; the _upper counts read an unmeasurable clause the other way

predefined_rule: The rule in the docstring of python/tools/evaluate_voice_setup_arms.py.
